                 title: "store.Get returns (nil, nil) for a deleted reminder, causing nil dereference in api.owned"
                 body: "Crash in v1.4.0 (commit 9c41e7a), reports cr_1e2ea0 (x2) and cr_ee551c (x1): panic \"invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference\" at api/reminders.go:144 (api.(*API).owned, `rem.UserID`), reached via getReminder and markDone.\n\nCause: store/store.go Get. For a tombstoned (Deleted) reminder the switch sets r = nil but leaves err nil, so Get returns (nil, nil). owned checks only err, then dereferences rem. Repro from the logs: POST /v1/reminders creates rem_0001, DELETE /v1/reminders/rem_0001 returns 204, then GET and POST /done on rem_0001 panic.\n\nFix: store/store.go Get sets err = ErrNotFound in the Deleted case, so callers get a 404 as for missing IDs. Other callers of Store.Get (api/lists.go:56, api/lists.go:113, api/search.go:31) are protected by the same fix.\n\nReproducer: store/deleted_get_test.go TestGetDeleted (fails before the fix: \"Get(deleted) error = <nil>, want ErrNotFound\")."
